full_judgment: 16. That dictum is relied upon further in conjunction with the methodology of exercise of discretion drawn by Mr Hassan Ariff from the ratio decidendi in Barium Chemicals Ltd. vs Company Law Board reported in AIR 1967 SC 295. The governing principle according to Mr Hassan Ariff drawn from the Barium ratio is that the Selection Committee acts as a collegium arriving at a collective decision with the presumption, however, of each member arriving at an independent decision and each such decision being reflected duly in the aggregate decision reached. That, according to Mr Hassan Ariff, is indeed the tenor and purport of Rules 9(1) and 9(3) as well. However, the petitioners contend, the facts show that such procedure has not been followed in either instance and it is here that they detect a legal infirmity in the decision making process stemming from a violation of express provisions of the law.
